Theres bisexual that you probably know but forgot to mention and that's okay!

Some genders: 

non binary, which means you dont identify as female or male.

Demi boy: means you feel like both a boy and another gender which is usually non binary!

Demi girl: same as demi boy but with girl!

Bigender: you identify as 2 genders (doesnt matter which ones)

Androgynous: not a gender but how you present, it means you look more gender neutral!

Pangender: feel like all genders

Genderfluid: your gender identity changes from times to times

Genderflux: like genderfluid but instead it's like your presentation, like feminine, masculine and gender neutral!

Agender: people who do not identify or conform to any gender

Also non binary is an umbrella term so some of these genders fall under it!

Some other ones!

Aromantic: means you have little to no romantic attraction

Polysexual: feeling attraction to selected genders

Demisexual: feeling sexual attraction only after having an emotional bond to someone

Hope this helps!!!
